paperTitle: SENTINELA: A Remote Cyber-Physical Patient Monitoring System
centralContribution: This work introduces SENTINELA, a novel remote cyber-physical patient monitoring system leveraging Computer Vision technologies, specifically Optical Character Recognition (OCR), to provide continuous and contactless monitoring of vital signs from any multiparametric monitor screen in Intensive Care Units (ICUs). The system aims to support healthcare teams in decision-making by detecting critical health problems, generating alerts, and minimizing doctor-patient interaction, thereby enhancing comprehensive care and biosafety.

gameObjects.visualMetaphor: The global spread of infectious diseases has strained healthcare systems, requiring minimal physical interaction for critically ill patients in ICUs. Traditional monitoring increases workload and biosafety risks. Existing Computer Vision and OCR techniques struggle with diverse real-world factors like text variations, lighting, noise, and dynamic screen layouts, hindering accurate data extraction. SENTINELA addresses this by offering a robust, low-cost, automated solution for remote vital sign monitoring and critical condition alerts.
gameObjects.whyThisFive: Summarizes the paper's context, problem statement, and the proposed solution, SENTINELA.
